name: SharedWorkspaceFiles
description: A collection of the SharedWorkspaceFile objects in the current shared workspace.
example:
Dim swsFiles As Office.SharedWorkspaceFiles
    Set swsFiles = ActiveWorkbook.SharedWorkspace.Files
    MsgBox "There are " & swsFiles.Count & _
        " file(s)
        vbInformation + vbOKOnly, _
        "Collection Information"
    Set swsFiles = Nothing

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SharedWorkspaceFile object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SharedWorkspaceFiles object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a SharedWorkspaceFile object from the Files collection of the shared workspace. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the SharedWorkspaceFiles collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SharedWorkspaceFiles object. Read-only.

properties.name: ItemCountExceeded
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the number of files allowed in the shared workspace has been exceeded. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(FileName As String, [ParentFolder As Variant], [OverwriteIfFileAlreadyExists As Variant], [KeepInSync As Variant]) As SharedWorkspaceFile
methods.description: Adds a file to the document library in a shared workspace. Returns a SharedWorkspaceFile object.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the file to be added to the current shared workspace.

parameters.name: ParentFolder
parameters.description: The subfolder in which to place the file, if not the main document library folder within the shared workspace. Add the file to the main document library folder by leaving this optional argument empty.

parameters.name: OverwriteIfFileAlreadyExists
parameters.description: True to overwrite an existing file by the same name. Default is False.

parameters.name: KeepInSync
parameters.description: True to keep the local copy of the document synchronized with the copy in the shared workspace. Default is False.
